checks.check: Every row is dated inside the chosen dates
Each work order appears once
Every row has an advisor
Totals row = sum of the rows (Days Open, Lines, Hrs Worked, Hrs Invoiced, Labor Delta, Parts Cost/Invoiced/Profit, Total Profit, Subtotal)
Totals row Billing Efficiency, ELR, Parts Margin, Total Margin recalculated from the totals
Lines = number of lines on the work order that were not declined
Labor Delta = Hrs Invoiced - Hrs Worked
Hrs Worked = clocked hours on the Stats tab (re-confirm)
Hrs Invoiced = billed hours on the Stats tab (re-confirm)
Billing Efficiency = Hrs Invoiced / Hrs Worked x 100; N/A when nothing clocked
Labor billed (behind ELR / Total Profit) = labor sell on the Stats tab
ELR = labor sold / hours clocked
Parts Cost = parts cost on the Stats tab
Parts Invoiced = parts sell on the Stats tab
Parts Profit = Parts Invoiced - Parts Cost
Parts Margin = Parts Profit / Parts Invoiced x 100
Total Profit = (labor sold - labor cost) + Parts Profit (Stats tab labor cost)
Total Margin = Total Profit / (labor sold + Parts Invoiced) x 100
Subtotal = the invoice subtotal on the invoice record
Days Open = days from the work order start to the invoice (rounded up)
Work order with no lines on its Stats tab shows 0 in every column
Advisor filter shows exactly that advisor's rows
Advisor filter: Totals row = that advisor's rows only
